_help: MapTiler tile sets offered by RT_OSM in the 'Map source' list.
include: true shows the entry in the list, false hides it. Entries with an empty url, or kind 'vector' or 'terrain', can never be used.
url: a Web-Mercator {z}/{x}/{y} template; {key} is replaced by your MapTiler key (RT_OSM dialog, or the MAPTILER_API_KEY variable).
tile_px: pixels per tile side the source serves (used to choose the output pixel size). max_zoom: the finest zoom it serves.
kind: raster | raster-dem | vector | terrain. verified: true = the URL was seen working or taken from MapTiler's documentation.
To add a tile set, copy an entry. The exact id is on its page at https://cloud.maptiler.com/tiles/. Delete this file to get the defaults back.
MapTiler's terms apply: key required, credit and logo are added to the drawing by RT_OSM.
